note: Printed exactly as shown. 'fatal science' is a misprint - the chapter carries no topic of that name. The chapter's section 6 is 'Embryological Evidences', which compares the embryonic development of eight chordates (fish, salamander, tortoise, chicken, pig, cow, rabbit, man) in fig. 1.10, so the intended word is the embryo/foetal science, i.e. embryology. Stem left as printed; the reading is explained in the solution.
